success_rate.frontend: 100% (all data-testids verified, full reports console tested)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 7 Reports & Audit is fully functional. Backend endpoints tested: GET /api/svc/reports/summary (with date range, from>to validation, ISO without Z), GET /api/svc/reports/revenue-by-engineer (sorted by revenue desc), GET /api/svc/reports/ftfr (first-time-fix rate calculation), GET /api/svc/reports/sla (SLA compliance with by_priority breakdown), GET /api/svc/reports/ai (AI observability with p50/p95 latency), GET /api/svc/reports/audit (paginated with filters). All endpoints require auth and respect org-scoping. Frontend verified: reports-page, reports-range, reports-refresh, reports-kpis (6 KPI cards), reports-revenue with revenue-rows, reports-sla with sla-rate and sla-by-priority, reports-ftfr with ftfr-rate, reports-ai with ai-row-{kind} for triage/photo_classify/summary/tiebreak, reports-audit with audit-list. Service Desk header has desk-reports-link routing to /service-ops/reports.

mocked_apis.sage_200_invoice_push: Outbox only - svc_sage_invoice_outbox.status flips draft → ready; live POST in Phase 8

backend: GET /api/svc/reports/summary - returns {from, to, kpis: {open_cases, cases_closed, chargeable_invoiced, revenue_gross, revenue_net, ai_calls}}
GET /api/svc/reports/revenue-by-engineer - returns {rows: [{engineer_id, engineer_name, hours, revenue, cases}]} sorted by revenue desc
GET /api/svc/reports/ftfr - returns {total_closed, ftf, rate} where ftf = closed cases without paused_parts state
GET /api/svc/reports/sla - returns {total, on_time, breached, rate, by_priority: {p1:{total,on_time,breached},...}}
GET /api/svc/reports/ai - returns {by_kind: [{kind, calls, ok, ok_rate, p50_latency_ms, p95_latency_ms, prompt_chars, response_chars}], totals}
GET /api/svc/reports/audit - returns paginated svc_case_events with limit, actor_id, types, case_id filters
All endpoints require authentication (401 without token)
frontend: Service Desk header has 'Reports' link (desk-reports-link) routing to /service-ops/reports
Reports page (reports-page) renders with header, range selector (reports-range), refresh button (reports-refresh)
KPI strip (reports-kpis) shows 6 cards: kpi-open-cases (87), kpi-cases-closed (6), kpi-chargeable-invoiced (0), kpi-revenue (£1,447.2), kpi-ftfr (100% with 6/6 sub-text), kpi-ai-calls (20)
Revenue per engineer section (reports-revenue) renders revenue-rows with horizontal bars sized by % of max
SLA section (reports-sla) renders sla-rate (100%), sla-by-priority list with sla-priority-p2, sla-priority-p3 entries
AI section (reports-ai) renders ai-row-triage, ai-row-photo_classify, ai-row-summary, ai-row-tiebreak with calls, ok %, p50, p95 columns
Audit feed (reports-audit) renders audit-list with audit-row-{event_id} entries showing case ref, type, actor, timestamp
